note: Public legislative texts of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, as published by the Income and Sales Tax Department (ISTD). Copies are kept for reproducibility; the official texts remain authoritative.

laws.title_ar: قانون ضريبة الدخل رقم (34) لسنة 2014 وتعديلاته
laws.title_en: Income Tax Law No. 34 of 2014, as amended
laws.version_notes: ISTD consolidated text. Original law published in Official Gazette No. 5320 on 31/12/2014. The file's footnotes mark each article changed by Law No. 38 of 2018 and note Constitutional Court decision No. 7 of 2018 on article 72; they are kept as article notes. File last saved 2022-01-04. Later amendments, if any, are not reflected.

laws.title_ar: قانون الضريبة العامة على المبيعات رقم (6) لسنة 1994 وتعديلاته
laws.title_en: General Sales Tax Law No. 6 of 1994, as amended
laws.format: pdf (Word 2010 export with broken ToUnicode maps; repaired, see SOURCES.md)
amendments_included: Amending Law No. 15 of 2022 (supply-based taxation, article 4 bis, faster refunds), plus earlier amendments
laws.version_notes: ISTD consolidated text labelled September 2022 (ايلول 2022). This edition carries no list of amending laws itself; the inclusion of Law No. 15 of 2022 is inferred from its content (article 4 مكرر, 'توريد' definitions, 30-day refunds) matching ISTD's September 2022 announcements of that law. The schedules (الجداول) annexed to the law are not part of the file and are not included. Later amendments, if any, are not reflected.
